M0.guarantee_statement: E[1 - recall] <= 0.16700000000000004 in expectation over the randomness of the calibration set (N=5 people) and a fresh exchangeable person. This is an average-case guarantee over hypothetical new people, NOT a high-probability/PAC statement about recall on one specific new person (Angelopoulos et al. 2022/2024; Cohen et al. 2024 Theorem 1).
